migrateModal.title: Switch source: {{title}}

modeHint.copy: Adds the target to the library and moves progress over; the current entry stays untouched
modeHint.migrate: Adds the target to the library and moves progress over; the current entry leaves the library and its reading progress is cleared
modeHint.migrateWithHistory: Adds the target to the library and moves progress over; the current entry leaves the library but keeps its reading history

migrateModal.searchHint: All target sources are searched by title concurrently (3 at a time).
migrateModal.noHits: No matches. Adjust the destination set and search again.
